title: Ensure Final Newline
summary: A Claude Code hook that makes sure each edited text file ends with exactly one newline, matching the line endings the file already uses.
description: Many tools complain when a file has no newline at the end, and extra blank lines at the end show up in review. This PostToolUse hook fixes both after every Edit or Write.
It keeps CRLF for files that already use it, leaves empty and binary files alone, and skips diff, patch and minified files.
useWhen: Stop "no newline at end of file" warnings in diffs
Keep POSIX tools happy with agent-written files
Remove stacked blank lines at the end of a file
Match the line endings of an existing file

hook.command:
node -e "process.on('uncaughtException',()=>process.exit(0));let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'');const fs=require('fs');const rd=()=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')}catch(e){return null}};const e=require('path').extname(f).toLowerCase();if(['.diff','.patch'].includes(e)||f.includes('.min.'))process.exit(0);const t=rd();if(t===null||t.includes(String.fromCharCode(0)))process.exit(0);let k=t.length;while(k>0&&(t[k-1]==='
'||t[k-1]===''))k--;if(k===0)process.exit(0);const o=t.slice(0,k)+(t.includes('
')?'
':'
');if(o!==t)fs.writeFileSync(f,o);process.exit(0)})"

example.prompt: Create a .gitignore for a Node project.
example.result: The file was saved without a final newline. The hook adds one so the diff shows a clean last line.

faq.question: What if my file uses Windows line endings?
faq.answer: If the file already contains CRLF pairs the added ending is CRLF too. Otherwise a plain newline is used.

faq.question: Does it change the middle of a file?
faq.answer: No. It only trims blank lines after the last real content and adds one ending.

access: Rewrites it only when the ending differs
